body.name: U
body.space: countable FFRCISTG response-type space over a finite treatment horizon
body.def: \(U=\{(Y_{\ell}^{\bar a},D_{\ell}^{\bar a}):\ell\le K,\bar a\in\{0,1\}^{K}\}\), where every raw count \(Y_{\ell}^{\bar a}\in\mathbb Z_+\) is nondecreasing and death \(D_{\ell}^{\bar a}=1\) is absorbing with no later raw count increment. The horizon and branch set are finite, but raw count coordinates are not capped by \(H\).
